## Description

AI has lowered the barrier to programming, but not removed the need for judgment. An accountant who can ask an LLM for a R script, read it critically, test it and run it can automate work that was out of reach before. This session teaches that complete loop. We use chat tools and in-editor assistants to generate analysis code, learn to read what the AI produced, build in tie-outs and tests, and produce a reproducible report. You will learn the habits that separate dependable AI-assisted code from code that merely runs: small steps, checking against known totals, version control and clear documentation.

:::{.callout-tip}

## Note

This session sits in the [R arena](../r.qmd), right after "Elevate Accounting with Analytics in R". A parallel session, [AI with Python](AI-Python.qmd), serves the Python arena.

:::

## Length

8 hours.

## Key Takeaways

Upon completion of this course, you will understand:

- How to describe an accounting task so an LLM produces useful code (inputs, outputs, edge cases)
- How to read, run and critique AI-generated code well enough to catch wrong logic, silent errors and unsafe operations
- How to debug with AI: reading error messages, isolating problems, asking better follow-ups
- How to build checks into analysis: control totals, row counts and reconciliation to source
- How to make AI-assisted work reproducible: scripts and Quarto reports, and version history
- What data to keep out of AI tools, and how to work with synthetic or masked data

## Workflows We Will Work Through

Hands-on exercises use realistic, simulated (never confidential) data. Examples include:

- Combining and cleaning monthly ledger exports from many files
- Aging analysis and expected-credit-loss style calculations on receivables
- Fuzzy matching of bank transactions to ledger entries
- Automating a recurring reporting package and rendering it as a document
- Querying a database with AI-written SQL and checking results against known totals

## Target Audience

- **Accountants who have completed the R sessions** and want to go much faster
- **Accountants already using R** who want a disciplined way to work with AI

## Prerequisite(s)

Completion of [Elevate Accounting with Analytics in R](ElevateAccountingWithAnalytics-R.qmd) or equivalent hands-on R experience is required. You need to understand code to trust it, so this session builds on the fundamentals rather than replacing them. See the [R Setup Guide](Setup-R.qmd) for the tools.
